metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-67. - Staged construction of facilities.
content.summary:
The terms of this article are in no manner intended to prevent the staged construction
               of any of the facilities herein regulated subject to approval of the city engineer.
(Code 1981, § 30-82; Ord. No. 1432, § 4, 3-6-1978)
